envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in Step 1 of every test case
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login Step 2
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login Step 4

TD-CS-24-HP-001.name: Valid Subcontracting PO — Single Component
TD-CS-24-HP-001.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created with unique PO number; item category L; special stock indicator O; component list populated from BOM; PO status Open/Sent

TD-CS-24-HP-002.name: Component Issue to CMO — Movement Type 541
TD-CS-24-HP-002.expectedOutcome: Material document posted with movement type 541; component stock reduced at issuing plant; stock provided to vendor (special stock O) increased at CMO for subcontracting PO

TD-CS-24-HP-003.name: Goods Receipt with Auto-Consumption of Components
TD-CS-24-HP-003.expectedOutcome: Goods receipt posted for finished material; component stock at CMO (special stock O) automatically consumed per BOM; inspection lot created if QM active

TD-CS-24-HP-004.name: Stock Overview Query — View CMO Component Balances
TD-CS-24-HP-004.expectedOutcome: Stock Overview displays component material stock provided to vendor (special stock O); balance matches issued quantity minus consumed quantity

TD-CS-24-AP-001.name: Subcontracting PO with Multiple Components (2-3 Components)
TD-CS-24-AP-001.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created; component list shows all components from multi-level BOM (2-3 items); each component line linked to subcontracting item

TD-CS-24-AP-002.name: Partial Goods Receipt — Less Than PO Quantity
TD-CS-24-AP-002.expectedOutcome: Partial goods receipt posted; components consumed proportionally to received quantity; PO remains open with remaining quantity; inspection lot created for partial quantity

TD-CS-24-NEG-001.name: Invalid Vendor — No Subcontracting Indicator
TD-CS-24-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Vendor not configured for subcontracting; item category L not allowed; PO not created

TD-CS-24-NEG-002.name: Invalid Material — No Subcontracting Item Category L Support
TD-CS-24-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Material not configured for subcontracting; item category L not allowed; PO not created

TD-CS-24-NEG-003.name: Invalid Component — Component Not in BOM
TD-CS-24-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Component not assigned to BOM for finished material; material document not posted; stock not issued

TD-CS-24-NEG-004.name: Insufficient Component Stock at Vendor for Goods Receipt
TD-CS-24-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Insufficient component stock at vendor (special stock O); goods receipt blocked or posted with warning; backflush fails

TD-CS-24-ERR-001.name: Missing Supplier — Empty Supplier Field
TD-CS-24-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Supplier field as mandatory; prevents submission; Order button disabled or submission blocked

TD-CS-24-ERR-002.name: Missing Material — Empty Material Field
TD-CS-24-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Material field as mandatory; prevents submission; Order button disabled or submission blocked

TD-CS-24-ERR-003.name: Missing Plant — Empty Plant Field
TD-CS-24-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Plant field as mandatory; prevents submission; Order button disabled or submission blocked

TD-CS-24-ERR-004.name: Missing Quantity — Empty Order Quantity Field
TD-CS-24-ERR-004.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Enter a quantity / Please enter an order quantity; prevents submission; Order button disabled or submission blocked

TD-CS-24-ERR-005.name: Missing Delivery Date — Empty Delivery Date Field
TD-CS-24-ERR-005.expectedOutcome: SAP highlights Delivery Date field as mandatory; prevents submission; Order button disabled or submission blocked

TD-CS-24-ERR-006.name: Missing or Wrong Item Category — Standard Item Category Instead of L
TD-CS-24-ERR-006.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Item category required for subcontracting; components not exploded; PO not created or saved with incorrect category

TD-CS-24-EDGE-001.name: Minimum Quantity Boundary — Quantity = 1
TD-CS-24-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created with quantity 1; components exploded per BOM for 1 unit; PO status Open/Sent

TD-CS-24-EDGE-002.name: Zero Quantity — Invalid Boundary
TD-CS-24-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Enter a quantity / Order quantity must be greater than 0; prevents submission; PO not created

TD-CS-24-EDGE-003.name: Maximum Quantity Boundary — Upper Limit
TD-CS-24-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created with maximum quantity; components exploded per BOM for max quantity; PO status Open/Sent; net order value calculated correctly

TD-CS-24-EDGE-004.name: Delivery Date Today — Same Day Delivery
TD-CS-24-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created with delivery date = today; SAP may display warning about immediate delivery; PO status Open/Sent

TD-CS-24-EDGE-005.name: Past Delivery Date — Date in the Past
TD-CS-24-EDGE-005.expectedOutcome: SAP displays warning: Delivery date is in the past; PO may be created with warning or blocked depending on system config

TD-CS-24-EDGE-006.name: Component Quantity Override to Zero
TD-CS-24-EDGE-006.expectedOutcome: SAP displays error: Component quantity must be greater than 0; material document not posted; issue blocked

TD-CS-24-INT-001.name: MM-IM Integration — Full Subcontracting Flow (PO + Issue + GR)
TD-CS-24-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created; component issued with movement type 541 to special stock O at CMO; goods receipt posted for finished material; components auto-consumed; stock balances updated correctly across MM and IM

TD-CS-24-INT-002.name: MM-QM Integration — Goods Receipt with Inspection Lot Creation
TD-CS-24-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Goods receipt posted for finished material; inspection lot automatically created per QM master record; finished goods stock posted to quality inspection stock (not unrestricted); inspection lot status = Released for Inspection

TD-CS-24-INT-003.name: MM-PP-BOM Integration — BOM Explosion and Component Determination
TD-CS-24-INT-003.expectedOutcome: Subcontracting PO created; system accesses BOM master (PP module) for finished material and plant; component list auto-populated with all active BOM components; component quantities calculated per BOM explosion
